Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a project to improve asthma care for medicaid-eligible children.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reducing complications related to asthma;creating a new section; making an appropriation; and providing anexpiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall establish a projectin a county west of the crest of the Cascade mountains with apopulation of more than seven hundred fifty thousand people to improvemanaging symptoms and reducing complications related to asthma amongmedicaid-eligible children. The department shall contract with thehealth department of the county in which the project is located to havetrained community health workers visit medicaid-eligible children intheir homes to identify and reduce exposure to asthma triggers, improvetheir self-management skills, and coordinate their care with theirprimary care and specialty providers. The contract shall include anevaluation of the services provided under the contract, including theirimpact on urgent physician's visits, emergency room utilization, andinpatient hospitalization. (2) The project must be completed by June 30, 2012. p. 1 HB 2481 (3) A report based upon the evaluation must be delivered to theappropriate committees of the legislature by December 1, 2012.

The sum of two hundred sixty-eight thousanddollars, or as much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated forthe fiscal year ending June 30, 2009, from the general fund to thedepartment of social and health services for the purposes of this act.
